patterns.note: Alternating light grey and white background sections for visual segmentation, with content consistently centered within a max-width container.
Large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles, often centered, contrasted with a playful script font for a key brand message in the footer.
Consistent use of a vibrant yellow for all primary calls-to-action and key accent elements, providing a clear visual hierarchy against a dark navy and white base palette.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they enter the viewport. A promotional banner appears at the top of the page after initial scroll, and the hero background exhibits a subtle parallax effect.
Product carousels feature clean, uniform cards with product images, names, and pricing, navigable via subtle side arrows and pagination dots.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations are used to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-up effect as they enter the viewport. The hero background utilizes a fixed attachment or parallax effect, allowing foreground content to scroll over it. A promotional banner is dynamically revealed at the top of the page after the user initiates scrolling, and a floating action button remains sticky in the bottom-right corner.

The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure high contrast for white text. Product listings are presented in clean, card-based layouts with consistent spacing and subtle border radii, facilitating easy browsing.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) and smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout, with an airy hero section and consistent padding around content blocks.

standout: The site stands out with its distinctive use of a playful script font for a key brand message in the footer, contrasting effectively with the modern sans-serif typography. This, combined with the specific bright yellow accent and the subtle wave graphic, creates a fresh and approachable yet professional brand identity.
